column1: # The code checks of the judge engine (ADR-0135 addendum (2) item 7, addendum (13) item 4; task P02.48, the decisions of the Architect on it and on the
# question of task P02.49): rows of the kinds of the closed dictionary forms/code-rules.tsv, which defines the columns, the outcome and the checks; no
# expected answer. Judge only: in the J input, not in the model input of a product. The generation cycle of the engine checks the rows on the code of the
# engine by the interpreter of the dictionary; the acceptance does not read them. A path of args names a file of the J input, relative to its root.
# The map: the file code-map.json in the directory from which the generation cycle runs the engine command, one JSON object. Its keys are the adapter
# names, each optional: stand (start and stop of the stand processes), transport (sockets and HTTP to the stand and the stub), files (reading the files
# of the J input, writing the report). A value is the import path of a package of the main module of the engine, as go list prints it. A missing map,
# another key or a value that is not such a package fails every row as no mapping.
# name: a set of packages of the main module of the engine, its nontest packages that go list names for the default build context; not a key of the map.
# module — every package of the main module, the adapters and the packages named main included. core — every package of module other than the packages
# that the map names and the packages named main; the package main joins the core and the adapters, imports both and stays out of the core. A row holds
# when its check holds on each package of the set; an empty set fails the row; a failing row names the package. The name type of both names is package.
# Paths: the engine opens a file of the J input only by a path that a cell of a form of the J input gives, joined to the root that the engine command
# receives (--spec); no string literal of module begins with Platform/ (the prefix of the rows of no_literals). The words of the forms are data of the J
# input: no case clause and no composite literal of module lists them, and no literal of module is the id or the owner of a target.
# stage: the stage of the generation cycle of the engine from which the row holds (tables, plan, own_tests, run_form); another word is a data error.
# norm: the norms of the subject.
